outcome: choice of health institution for delivery (public vs. private)
cohort: 300 women in Chandigarh, India who had delivered a baby in the previous three months (150 in public and 150 in private institutions).
finding: Socio-economic status, quality of infrastructure, and quality of care were associated with the choice of institution for delivery.
mod_finding: 30% of women in private institutions had cesarean deliveries compared to 17.3% in public institutions.
